responsibility: This C header provides the C-language mirror of mc’s token enumeration. It exports the mcReserved_toktype enum with the same lexical token set used by the Modula-2 side, allowing generated or handwritten C lexer code and other foreign interfaces to exchange token codes consistently with mcReserved.def and mcLexBuf.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the C-language mirror of the mcReserved token set, defining a prefixed mcReserved_toktype enum for C code; unlike mcReserved.def it is not a Modula-2 definition module, and unlike mcReserved.mod it contains the usable foreign-language declaration.
